title: No-limit runner row
description: The tokenless runner's row on the tracking strip (DOCS-nolimit.md): whether it works now (no Claude route can run a turn) and the last repo it visited with that visit's result. Inside GET /api/usage as `nolimit`.

active.description: The trigger held at the last tick.

repo.description: The ~/src checkout of the last visit; null before the first.

result.description: deployed / pushed: green gate, fixes on origin; green: green gate, nothing pushed; red: a step failed (tickets filed); slow: a step cut at 60 s; stopped: a Claude route opened; readonly: no gate, lint only.
